description: Initial Phase 4A native smoke comparison, before the live-discovered deadline repair

limitations: Native host permissions, not isolated grading or authorization certification.
Three development missions, not the complete Zeus Benchmark v1.
Token units are not subscription credits. Unknown usage is not zero.
summary.token_note: Runtime-reported token units are not provider credits or a context-length estimate. Raw cache/reasoning fields are preserved separately, not added to the total; gateway cache semantics may differ.

comparison.note: Descriptive development comparison, not statistical proof. Negative latency/token deltas are reductions; inspect success and coverage first.

retained_failure.reason: Wrong note selector exhausted a 30-second script while the locator also had a 30-second default. In-flight owner cleanup ended the browser and prevented recovery.
retained_failure.scope: One observed failure; not proof that checkpoint prompting caused it. Deadline repair and its follow-up are separate.
